title: Rig Relay Validate Invocation v1
description: Invocation arguments for a validate profile run. Describes which profile, scope, paths, and policy constraints to apply.

profile.description: Named validation profile (quick, python, schemas, receipt-policy, tool-hardening)

paths.description: Optional path scope for targeted validation

check_only.description: If true, only check without mutation (default: true)

allow_network.description: If true, allow network-requiring checks (default: false)

allow_mutation.description: If true, allow mutation-capable checks (default: false)

expected_dirty_policy.description: Expected workspace dirty policy (clean, allow_dirty, allow_listed_dirty)

cache_policy.description: Cache policy for validation results. enabled: cache hits return without execution. disabled: bypass cache. force_rerun: bypass cache and rerun.

allow_failed_cache_reuse.description: If true, reuse cache records from failed runs (default: false)

cache_root.description: Optional override for validation cache directory

scheduler_policy.description: Scheduler policy for duplicate detection. enabled: use running locks. disabled: bypass.

lock_running_checks.description: If true, prevent duplicate execution of same check (default: true)

validation_phase.description: Validation lifecycle phase. edit: warn on full suite. pre_report: normal.

parallel_policy.description: Parallel execution policy for pytest suites.

max_workers.description: Maximum parallel workers. Default: min(4, cpu_count)
